_comment: Skyline Together texts (English, the fallback). Keys: st.ui.* (UI module), st.toast.* (notifications), st.chat.* (system chat lines), st.options.* (Options page). Placeholders like {NAME} are replaced at runtime.
st.ui.title: Skyline Together
st.ui.button.tooltip: Play this city together with friends: host it, join a friend's city, chat.
st.ui.steam.missing.title: Steam is not available
st.ui.steam.missing.text: Skyline Together needs the Steam version of the game, with Steam running and logged in.
st.ui.profile.name: Your name
st.ui.host.title: Host this city
st.ui.host.intro: Open the city you are playing to your friends. They join with your Steam ID or a Steam invite.
st.ui.host.requireModsHint: Refuse players whose code mods differ from yours. They get a list of what to enable, disable or update.
st.ui.host.requireAssetsHint: Refuse players whose asset packs differ from yours. When off, they join, are told which packs differ, and objects from packs they don't have are left out in their game.
st.ui.host.allowModOverride: Let players join with different mods
st.ui.host.allowModOverrideHint: When a player's mods or asset packs don't match what you require, they see what differs and can still choose "Join anyway". Their game may then behave differently; your city stays authoritative. DLC, version and password checks always apply.
st.ui.host.allowDirectHint: Also accept connections on a UDP port (needs port forwarding and a host password). Steam connections always work.
st.ui.host.allowDirectNextTime: Applies the next time you host.
st.ui.host.friendsOnlyHint: Only your Steam friends and players you invite from this panel can join through Steam. Direct IP joiners still need the password.
st.ui.host.newPlayersViewerHint: Players joining for the first time in this session can watch but not build until you make them builders in the player list. Players who were here before keep their role when they rejoin.
st.ui.host.allowDirectNeedsPassword: Set a password first: Steam does not check direct connections, so the password is what keeps strangers out.
st.ui.host.bansHint: Banned players can't join your sessions until you unban them.
st.ui.host.needCity: Load or start a city first, then host it from there.
st.ui.host.unavailable: Hosting isn't possible right now. Wait until the city has finished loading, and leave any running session first.
st.ui.join.title: Join a friend
st.ui.join.intro: Enter the host's Steam ID (shown in their Skyline Together panel) or IP address and port.
st.ui.join.target: Host's Steam ID or IP address
st.ui.join.badSteamId: A Steam ID has 17 digits. Copy it from the host's Skyline Together panel.
st.ui.join.badPort: The port after the colon must be a number from 1 to 65535.
st.ui.join.badTarget: Enter the host's Steam ID (17 digits) or an address like 203.0.113.7:27015.
st.ui.join.unavailable: Joining isn't possible right now. Wait until the game has finished loading, and leave any running session first.
st.ui.join.steamHint: Got a Steam invite? Accept it in Steam and the game joins by itself.
st.ui.join.replaceWarning: Joining replaces the city you are playing with the host's city. Save first.
st.ui.join.stage.waiting: The host is saving the city
st.ui.join.hint.handshaking: Making sure both games run the same versions and mods.
st.ui.join.hint.waiting: The host's game saves the city for you. Large cities take a moment.
st.ui.join.hint.loading: Your game is loading the host's city. The session starts right after.
st.ui.join.patience: Large cities take a few minutes to download and load.
st.ui.end.joinAnywayWarning: Different mods can make your cities drift apart or behave differently. The host's city is authoritative; differences are repaired where possible.
st.ui.end.text.badPassword: The host didn't accept the password. Check it with the host and try again. After several wrong tries the host's game blocks new attempts for a while.
st.ui.end.text.lockout: The host's game blocks new attempts from your connection for a while after several wrong passwords. Wait until the time below has passed, check the password with the host, then try again.
st.ui.end.text.passwordRequired: Ask the host for the password and enter it below.
st.ui.end.title.mods: Your mods don't match the host's
st.ui.end.text.mods: The host requires the same code mods. Change these, restart the game and join again.
st.ui.end.text.modsOverridable: Your code mods differ from the host's. Best: change these, restart the game and join again. The host also lets you join anyway.
st.ui.end.text.game: You both need the same game version. Update the game on the PC with the older version (restarting Steam usually does it), then join again.
st.ui.end.text.build: You both need exactly the same Skyline Together build. Install the same release on both PCs (the build id is at the bottom of the panel), then join again.
st.ui.end.title.content: You're missing DLC or content packs the host has
st.ui.end.text.content: The host owns these DLC or content packs, and their city can contain objects from them that your game can't load. Get them (Steam or the Paradox launcher), restart the game and join again.
st.ui.end.title.assets: Your asset packs don't match the host's
st.ui.end.text.assets: The host requires the same asset packs. Subscribe to the missing ones, disable the ones the host doesn't have, update the others, restart the game and join again.
st.ui.end.text.assetsOverridable: Your asset packs differ from the host's. Best: subscribe to the missing ones, disable the ones the host doesn't have, update the others, restart the game and join again. The host also lets you join anyway.
st.ui.end.text.modsRequired: The host's city stores data of mods you don't have. Your game would crash loading it without them, so you can't join until you enable them – not even with Join anyway. Enable or subscribe to them, restart the game and join again.
st.ui.end.text.modsRequiredRest: The host's city stores data of mods you don't have. Your game would crash loading it without them, so you can't join until you enable them – not even with Join anyway. Enable or subscribe to them, restart the game and join again. The host lets you join anyway with the other differences once these are enabled.
st.ui.end.mods.requiredInCity: This city contains its data – loading it without the mod would crash the game.
st.ui.end.mods.requiredMaybe: It can store data in a city – loading the city without the mod can crash the game.
st.ui.end.text.conflictYou: The 'CS2 Multiplayer Mod' is enabled – two multiplayer mods at once conflict. Disable it in your playset or unsubscribe from it, restart the game and join again.
st.ui.end.text.conflictHost: The host has the 'CS2 Multiplayer Mod' enabled – two multiplayer mods at once conflict. Ask the host to disable it and restart the game, then join again.
st.ui.end.text.full: Ask the host to raise the player limit, or try again when someone leaves.
st.ui.end.text.notAllowed: This session is open to the host's Steam friends and invited players only. Ask the host to send you a Steam invite. Joining by IP address also needs the host's password.
st.ui.end.text.notReady: The host's session is still starting, or an earlier join attempt is still running. Try again in a moment.
st.ui.end.title.closing: The host is closing the session
st.ui.end.text.closing: The session is shutting down. Join again once the host hosts a new one.
st.ui.end.text.timeout: The host didn't answer in time. Check the Steam ID or address and make sure the host is hosting right now, then try again.
st.ui.end.text.lost: The connection to the host was interrupted. Try again; if it keeps happening, check your internet connection.
st.ui.end.title.kicked: You were removed from the session
st.ui.end.text.kicked: The host removed you from the session. You can join again if the host lets you.
st.ui.end.title.banned: You are banned from this session
st.ui.end.text.banned: The host banned you. Only the host can lift the ban.
st.ui.end.text.failed: Something went wrong while joining. Try again. If it keeps happening, use Copy details and attach them and the diagnostics file (Options → Skyline Together → Write diagnostics) to a bug report on GitHub (github.com/ljkx/SkylineTogether/issues).
st.ui.end.title.loadFailed: Your game couldn't load the host's city
st.ui.end.text.loadFailed: The city arrived, but loading it failed. Try again. If it keeps failing, make sure you have the host's map and assets. If it still fails, use Copy details and attach them to a bug report on GitHub (github.com/ljkx/SkylineTogether/issues).
st.ui.session.menuNote: A session is still running. Leave it before you host or join another one.
st.ui.session.holding: A player is joining – the game is paused until they are in.
st.ui.invite.title: Invite friends
st.ui.invite.direct: Direct connection: your public IP address and port {PORT}.
st.ui.players.title: Players
st.ui.players.pingHint: Time for a round trip to the host. Under 80 ms feels instant; above 250 ms actions show up late.
st.ui.session.cohost: You are a co-host: you can remove builders and viewers and switch them between building and watching.
st.ui.settings.title: Session settings
st.ui.chat.title: Chat
st.ui.chat.overlayPlaceholder: Say something… (Enter to send, Esc to close)
st.ui.perf.title: Performance
st.ui.perf.frame: Frame budget {MS} of {BUDGET} ms · {OVER} frames over
st.toast.title: Skyline Together
st.notice.assetsMissing: The host has asset packs you don't have: {LIST}. Objects from them are left out in your game. Subscribe to them and join again to see everything.
st.notice.assetVersions: These asset packs have another version than the host's: {LIST}. Some objects may be missing or look different; update them to match.
st.notice.assetsUnknown: Your asset packs differ from the host's (too many to list). Objects from packs you don't have are left out in your game.
st.notice.assetsExtra: You have asset packs the host doesn't have: {LIST}. The host can't place their objects, so building with them is undone.
st.notice.contentExtra: You have DLC or content packs the host doesn't have: {LIST}. Building with them is undone in this session.
st.notice.mods: Your code mods differ from the host's (the host allows it): {LIST}. Parts of the city may look or behave differently for you.
st.notice.settings: While you play together, the host's values apply to these mod settings: {LIST}. Yours come back when you leave.
st.notice.hostAssets: {NAME} doesn't have {N} of your asset packs. Objects from them won't appear in their game (the list is in the log).
st.notice.hostDiffers: {NAME} joined with other mods, DLC or mod settings than yours (details in the log).
st.notice.joinedAnyway: You joined with different mods: {LIST}. Different mods can make your cities drift apart or behave differently. The host's city is authoritative; differences are repaired where possible.
st.toast.conflictMod: The 'CS2 Multiplayer Mod' ({MOD}) is enabled: nobody can join you until you disable it and restart the game – two multiplayer mods at once conflict.
st.notice.hostCityData: {NAME} can't join: they don't have {LIST}, which store data in this city. Their game would crash loading it, so this can't be overridden.
st.notice.hostConflictJoiner: {NAME} can't join: they have the 'CS2 Multiplayer Mod' enabled – two multiplayer mods at once conflict.
st.notice.hostConflictSelf: {NAME} can't join because the 'CS2 Multiplayer Mod' is enabled in your game. Disable it and restart the game – two multiplayer mods at once conflict.
st.toast.hostingStarted: Hosting "{SESSION}". Friends join with your Steam ID {ID} or a Steam invite.
st.toast.hostNeedsCity: Load or start a city first, then host it.
st.toast.installedTwice: Skyline Together is installed twice ({COPIES}). Only one copy is loaded, and the other one can break the game or your sessions. Keep one: delete the folder Mods/SkylineTogether in the game's user data folder, or unsubscribe on Paradox Mods. Then restart the game.
st.toast.join.inSession: Already in a session. Leave it first.
st.toast.join.noSteam: Steam is not available. Start the game through Steam and log in.
st.toast.join.noTarget: Enter the host's Steam ID or address first.
st.toast.join.renderPrefabs: The host's city uses map or climate assets you do not have ({NAMES}). Subscribe to the host's map on Paradox Mods (or use the same map), then join again.
st.toast.join.loading: Your game is still loading. Wait until it has finished, then join.
st.toast.join.other: Joining is not possible right now.
st.toast.join.cityLoading: Joining was cancelled because another city is being loaded.
st.toast.join.waiting: {SESSION}: the host is saving the city…
st.toast.joined: Joined "{SESSION}". The city is in sync – have fun!
st.toast.inviteBusy: {NAME} invited you. Leave the current session first, then accept again.
st.toast.overlayUnavailable: The Steam overlay is not available (it is turned off, or the game was started without it), so the invite dialog cannot open. Invite friends from the list in the panel, or share the Steam ID {ID}.
st.toast.overlayNoResponse: The Steam invite dialog did not open. Invite friends from the list in the panel, or share the Steam ID {ID}.
st.toast.inviteNoSession: Host a session first, then invite friends.
st.toast.inviteFailed: Steam could not send the invite to {NAME}. Share the Steam ID {ID} instead.
st.toast.inviteConfirm: {NAME} invited you to a Skyline Together session. Click here to join – joining replaces the city you are playing, so save first.
st.toast.inviteUnreadable: Could not read the invite from {NAME}. Ask them to invite you again, or join with the host's Steam ID.
st.toast.inviteMoved: The invite from {NAME} is out of date: the host has left that session. Ask for a new invite, or join with the host's Steam ID.
st.toast.diagnosticsFailed: Could not write the diagnostics (see the log).
st.chat.hostingStarted: You are hosting "{SESSION}". Friends can join with your Steam ID {ID}.
st.chat.hostingDirect: Direct connections: your IP address and port {PORT}.
st.options.title: Skyline Together
st.options.PlayerName.label: Player name
st.options.PlayerName.desc: The name other players see. Empty: your Steam name.
st.options.ShowBuildingPreviews.label: Show other players' building previews
st.options.ShowBuildingPreviews.desc: While another player builds, draw what they see in their colour: the road or track being drawn, the building at their cursor, districts, zones being painted, lines, and what their bulldozer would remove.
st.options.SessionName.label: Session name
st.options.SessionName.desc: Shown to players who join. Empty: "<your name>'s city".
st.options.HostPassword.label: Password
st.options.HostPassword.desc: Players must enter this password to join. Empty: anyone with your Steam ID or address can join.
st.options.MaxPlayers.label: Max players
st.options.RequireSameMods.label: Require the same mods
st.options.RequireSameMods.desc: Refuse players whose code mods differ from yours. They get a list of what to enable or disable. Turning this off can make the city look or behave differently for them.
st.options.RequireSameAssets.label: Require the same asset packs
st.options.RequireSameAssets.desc: Refuse players whose asset packs (Paradox Mods packages that add objects) differ from yours. When off, they join, are told which packs differ, and objects from packs they don't have are left out in their game.
st.options.AllowJoinWithDifferentMods.la: Let players join with different mods
st.options.AllowJoinWithDifferentMods.de: When "Require the same mods" or "Require the same asset packs" refuses a player, they see what differs and can still choose "Join anyway". Their game may then behave differently; your city stays authoritative and differences are repaired where possible. DLC, version and password checks always apply.
st.options.FriendsOnly.label: Friends and invited only
st.options.FriendsOnly.desc: Only your Steam friends and players you invite from the Skyline Together panel can join through Steam. Others are told they are not invited.
st.options.NewPlayersJoinAsViewer.label: New players join as viewers
st.options.NewPlayersJoinAsViewer.desc: Players joining your session for the first time can watch but not build until you make them builders in the Skyline Together player list. A player who was in the session before keeps their role when they rejoin.
st.options.EnforcePlacementChecks.label: Enforce build checks on other players
st.options.EnforcePlacementChecks.desc: Undo other players' builds that a normal game could not make: locked buildings, unbought map tiles, impossible shapes. Off: such builds are kept and only written to the log, so a check that misjudges a legitimate build never undoes it.
st.options.AllowDirectConnections.label: Allow direct IP connections
st.options.AllowDirectConnections.desc: Also accept connections on a UDP port (needs port forwarding). Steam does not check these players, so a host password is required; without one the port stays closed. Steam connections always work without it.
st.options.DirectPort.label: Direct connection port
st.options.JoinTarget.label: Host's Steam ID or IP:port
st.options.JoinTarget.desc: The host's Steam ID (17 digits, shown in the host's Skyline Together panel) or IP address with port, e.g. 203.0.113.7:27015.
st.options.JoinPassword.label: Password
st.options.JoinPassword.desc: The session password, if the host set one.
st.options.HostButton.label: Host this city
st.options.HostButton.desc: Open the city you are playing to other players. Load or start a city first.
st.options.JoinButton.label: Join
st.options.JoinButton.desc: Connect to the host above and load their city.
st.options.LeaveButton.label: Leave session
st.options.LeaveButton.desc: Disconnect (as host: end the session for everyone).
st.options.ShowNetworkHud.label: Show network line
st.options.ShowNetworkHud.desc: Show ping and network traffic (KB/s in and out) in the Skyline Together panel.
st.options.WriteDiagnosticsButton.label: Write diagnostics
st.options.WriteDiagnosticsButton.desc: Write a text file with the session state, players, network numbers, versions, mods and recent log lines next to the game's log. Attach it to your bug report on GitHub (github.com/ljkx/SkylineTogether/issues). It contains player names and Steam IDs; passwords and chat are not included.
st.ui.recovery.lost.title: Connection lost
st.ui.recovery.lost.text: Reconnecting in {S} s (attempt {N} of {MAX}). The city is paused until then; changes you make now are not kept.
st.ui.recovery.attempt.title: Reconnecting (attempt {N} of {MAX})
st.ui.recovery.ended.title: The session has ended
st.ui.recovery.ended.text: You can return to the main menu, or keep playing an offline copy of the host's city.
st.ui.recovery.kicked.title: You were removed from the session
st.ui.recovery.kicked.text: The host removed you. You can return to the main menu, or keep playing an offline copy of the host's city.
st.ui.recovery.banned.title: You were removed and banned
st.ui.recovery.banned.text: The host removed you and banned you from this session. You can return to the main menu, or keep playing an offline copy of the host's city.
st.ui.recovery.failed.title: Not connected
st.ui.recovery.failed.text: Reconnecting did not work. You can try again, return to the main menu, or keep an offline copy.
st.ui.resync.title: Your city differs from the host's
st.ui.resync.text: Parts of your city no longer match the host's, and automatic repairs couldn't fix them. Rejoin with a fresh copy of the host's city? It takes about as long as joining.
st.ui.profile.nameHint: Shown to the other players, on your cursor and in the chat.
st.ui.host.subtitle: Open the city you are playing to your friends
st.ui.host.sessionNameHint: What your friends see while they join.
st.ui.host.portHint: The UDP port players connect to directly (1024 to 65535).
st.ui.host.settingsNote: Saved right away and used the next time you host.
st.ui.host.menu.title: Hosting starts from inside your city
st.ui.host.menu.step1: Load a saved city or start a new one.
st.ui.host.menu.step2: Click the Skyline Together button in the top-left corner of the screen.
st.ui.host.menu.step3: Press "Host this city" and invite your friends.
st.ui.host.info: Your game keeps running the city as usual. Friends who join get a copy of it and from then on everything anyone builds is shared live.
st.ui.join.subtitle: Play together in a friend's city
st.ui.join.passwordHint: Only needed when the host set a password.
st.ui.join.info: The host's game saves the city and sends it to you; your game then loads it. Large cities take a minute. After that everything you and your friends build is shared live.
st.ui.join.findId: The host finds their Steam ID at the top of their Skyline Together panel and can copy it with one click.
st.ui.friends.title: Invite Steam friends
st.ui.friends.overlayOnly: Invite friends through Steam's invite dialog, or share your Steam ID.
st.ui.friends.noOverlay: The Steam overlay is not available. Share your Steam ID with your friends: they paste it on the Join page.
st.ui.diag.title: Network & diagnostics
st.ui.test.subtitle: Check the sync on this PC, no second player needed
st.ui.conflictMod: The 'CS2 Multiplayer Mod' ({MOD}) is enabled. Disable it and restart the game – two multiplayer mods at once conflict. While it is enabled, nobody can join you and you can't join others.
st.toast.blocked: Skyline Together cannot host or join in this game version: {REASON}. Please attach the diagnostics file to a bug report on GitHub (github.com/ljkx/SkylineTogether/issues).
st.toast.startFailed: Could not start the session: part of Skyline Together failed to start. Please attach the diagnostics file to a bug report on GitHub (github.com/ljkx/SkylineTogether/issues).
st.toast.join.recovering: Still recovering the last session. Reconnect, or choose to stay offline first.
st.toast.localSave: You saved a copy of the host's city on your computer. It is your own copy: the session goes on in the host's city, and the host keeps the real save.
st.toast.offlineCopy: You are playing an offline copy of the host's city. Saving it creates your own copy.
st.toast.mainMenuFailed: Could not return to the main menu: {ERROR}
st.toast.recovery.reconnecting: {REASON} Reconnecting automatically; the city is paused until then.
st.toast.recovery.ended: The session has ended: {REASON} Open the Skyline Together panel to return to the main menu or to keep an offline copy.
st.toast.recovery.fault: {REASON} Open the Skyline Together panel to reconnect.
st.toast.recovery.failed: Could not reconnect: {REASON} Open the Skyline Together panel to choose what to do.
st.toast.recovery.choose: {REASON} Open the Skyline Together panel to choose what to do.
st.toast.directNeedsPassword: Direct IP connections stay closed because no host password is set. Players can still join through Steam.
st.toast.recovery.kicked: {REASON} Open the Skyline Together panel to return to the main menu or to keep an offline copy.
st.toast.recovery.banned: {REASON} Open the Skyline Together panel to return to the main menu or to keep an offline copy.
st.toast.resyncOffered: Your city differs from the host's in many places. Open the Skyline Together panel to resync (rejoin with a fresh copy).
st.toast.critical.host: Skyline Together hit repeated errors in {FEATURE} and ended the session. Diagnostics were written; please attach them to a bug report on GitHub (github.com/ljkx/SkylineTogether/issues).
st.toast.critical.other: Skyline Together hit repeated errors in {FEATURE}. Please write diagnostics and attach them to a bug report on GitHub (github.com/ljkx/SkylineTogether/issues).
st.toast.featureOff: Skyline Together: {FEATURE} hit repeated errors and is off for this session. Please use "Write diagnostics" and attach the file to a bug report on GitHub (github.com/ljkx/SkylineTogether/issues).
st.toast.viewerFollow: You are a viewer in this session: ask the host to make you a builder to follow citizens.
st.toast.viewerEdit: You are a viewer in this session: ask the host to make you a builder to change the city.
st.toast.uiMissing: The Skyline Together panel did not load. Host, join and leave from Options → Skyline Together instead, and please attach the diagnostics file to a bug report on GitHub (github.com/ljkx/SkylineTogether/issues).
st.chat.offlineCopy: You are playing an offline copy of the host's city. Nothing you do here reaches the session.
st.chat.criticalLeft: This game hit repeated errors in {FEATURE}, so it left the session. Reconnect to get a fresh copy of the city.
st.ui.test.title: Solo test (no second PC needed)
st.ui.test.intro: Record a session on this PC, then replay it the way a joining player receives it. The replay checks that every object, line, icon and global value ends up exactly as on the host.
st.ui.test.recordHint: Records everything a joining player would receive while you play (if you aren't hosting, the city is hosted privately for the recording). Build and play as usual, then stop the recording.
st.ui.test.needCity: Load a city first to record a test session.
st.ui.test.replayBanner: Replaying a recording: nothing is sent over the network. At the end the verdict is saved next to the recording and the session ends.
st.ui.test.replayHint: Replaying loads the recorded city in place of the one you are playing. Save first.
st.replay.status.joining: The test recorder is joining (the host saves the city for it)…
st.replay.status.stopping: Finishing: a final checkpoint, then the recording is saved…
st.replay.status.playing: Replayed {TIME} of the recording · {N} checkpoints compared · {DIFF} objects differ
st.toast.record.unavailable: A test recording needs a loaded city (or your hosted session) and no other test running.
st.toast.record.started: Recording a test session. Build and play as usual; stop it in the Skyline Together panel.
st.toast.record.failed: The test recording could not start: {ERROR}
st.toast.record.saved: Test recording saved ({TIME}). Replay it from the panel with "Replay & verify".
st.toast.record.ended: The test recording ended early ({REASON}); the {TIME} recorded so far are kept.
st.toast.replay.unavailable: A replay can only start when no session is running and no city is loading.
st.toast.replay.version: That recording was made with another protocol version of Skyline Together and cannot be replayed.
st.chat.soloHost: Solo test session: nobody can join; the test recorder takes the joining player's place.
st.chat.replayStarted: Replaying the recording {NAME}. Nothing is sent over the network.
st.chat.resync: Rejoining for a fresh copy of the host's city…
st.toast.rejected: The host undid your last change: {REASON}.
st.reject.conflict: another player changed the same thing first
st.reject.noPermission: your role does not allow this (ask the host)
st.reject.outsideTiles: it is outside the map tiles the city owns
st.reject.invalid: the host could not use it
st.reject.notLive: you are not in the session
st.reject.hostError: the host could not apply it

st.net.chat.tooSlow: {NAME} could not keep up with the session and was disconnected; joining again catches up.

st.net.drop.tookTooLong: Joining took too long (more than {MINUTES} minutes). Try joining again.
st.net.drop.notResponding: The host received nothing from your game for {SECONDS} s. Join again to continue.
st.net.drop.failing: The host could not handle the data your game sends. Join again to get a fresh copy of the city.
st.net.drop.tooSlow: Your connection could not keep up with the session. Join again to catch up.
st.net.drop.downloadStalled: The city download made no progress for {SECONDS} s. Try joining again.
st.net.drop.loadStalled: Loading the city made no progress for {SECONDS} s. Try joining again.
st.net.drop.loadTooLong: Loading the city took more than {MINUTES} minutes. Try joining again.
st.net.drop.resends: The city download kept failing. Try joining again.
st.net.drop.snapshotFailed: The host could not save the city ({DETAIL}). Try joining again.
st.net.drop.applyFailed: The host could not apply your changes. Join again to get a fresh copy of the city.
st.net.drop.notApplying: Your game stopped applying the host's updates. Join again to get a fresh copy of the city.
st.net.drop.tooFast: Your game sent changes faster than the host could apply them. Join again to continue.
st.net.refuse.shuttingDown: The host is ending the session.
st.net.refuse.protocol: Skyline Together versions differ. Update both games to the same mod version.
st.net.refuse.protocolVersions: Skyline Together versions differ. Host: {HOST}. Update both games to the same mod version.
